lxc_b50897d3a45c33bc.text: First, we look at friendly language at work.

lxc_33e8b036d1875aba.text: Does a relaxed style mean an easy job?

lxc_91d4e4a5e818ed0d.text: Then we see how migration changed everyday food, with a short coffee story.

lxc_9898e00c998064bc.text: Next, we look at free time in parks, by the coast and in the city.

lxc_35b5ca8b7caf0dfa.text: Finally, we explore a new rule about work messages after hours.

lxc_0931011e718ae564.text: Imagine your first week at a new office in Australia.

lxc_857fbc202b4cf40a.text: In the kitchen, someone you work with asks about your weekend.

lxc_bce51ddbeda351c7.text: Many Australian workplaces are described as relaxed.

lxc_f18495db3d14c2c7.text: People often use first names, friendly expressions and short forms.

lxc_fbee6c0cc33583e9.text: This style can help people feel that they are part of the same team.

lxc_a91c0c05e1df146d.text: But a friendly style does not mean the work is unimportant.

lxc_f205c5e58f143115.text: In our imagined office, a colleague later offers to help you finish a report on time.

lxc_7345196f448e38ec.text: Friendly words make it easier to ask questions.

lxc_bc2fc1c4242e3103.text: The team still expects good work, clear plans and respect for other people's time.

lxc_e2d2814a8059e86d.text: This is a broad picture, not a rule.

lxc_169d57eeef3d68bb.text: A hospital, a bank and a building site can feel very different.

lxc_bedff6f393144b35.text: Some people use a more formal style than others.

lxc_540a7267c9205bd8.text: A good first step is to listen and follow the people around you.

lxc_9ffa7ab770e056fe.text: Food in Australia today is a mix of many stories.

lxc_8d0f8ceba6089a97.text: Australia's first and oldest stories belong to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples.

lxc_7c4c179202959acc.text: Later, people came from many countries, and migration shaped food and celebrations.

lxc_b1dafd0d0aba4445.text: Today, restaurants and cafes serve food from many countries.

lxc_c0d2a3f6f8f4b787.text: For many people, food is a way to celebrate this mixed identity.

lxc_e151728237985f6b.text: Coffee is a short, clear example.

lxc_1906d960df771fc3.text: After the Second World War, Greek and Italian migrants settled in Melbourne and Sydney.

lxc_38803469a5ebd273.text: Their coffee habits became part of city life.

lxc_c847089f174a10fa.text: Italian communities in regional Queensland also shaped how people drank coffee.

lxc_f9754823ea3576b1.text: So a daily cup of coffee can carry a migration story.

lxc_567a9daf526f81fa.text: The exact origin of the flat white is still unclear.

lxc_bd213f195871a0fd.text: Home food is often simple and shared.

lxc_bee661dde2d61d26.text: Friends and family gather for a barbecue in a backyard, in a park or at the beach.

lxc_a1757a599d29fc81.text: People may cook sausages, steak, chicken or prawns, and there are often plant-based options too.

lxc_aaeb28b52ce509fd.text: The meal is about time together, not only the food.

lxc_4283784d89849250.text: Most of Australia's big cities are along the coast.

lxc_e55253c6d17e9332.text: Because of this, many people can go to the beach for a swim or to a park for lunch.

lxc_5f0aabd317bf0273.text: On weekends, common social activities include brunch at a cafe, watching or playing sport, and walking in national parks near the city.

lxc_6f9116035c3d7ec3.text: Real examples show that outdoor life looks different in different places.

lxc_f5c1a5bac272355e.text: In Sydney, some people enjoy swimming in the ocean at sunrise.

lxc_e7fbf42351805451.text: In Canberra, people take weekend bike rides around the lake.

lxc_78a0b5118e0e3c15.text: In Perth, people enjoy picnics in Kings Park.

lxc_24693cc1d3b83395.text: So outdoor time is not only about surfing.

lxc_b2a1166955008d9a.text: It can mean a bike, a blanket on the grass or a quiet walk.

lxc_cca20d70ec0c034b.text: These are common activities, not habits of every person.

lxc_12d3ca2eff25ea19.text: Holiday pictures show sunny, happy moments, but daily life also has work, travel time, family life and money to think about.

lxc_ad474f8639e75171.text: Someone who works on Saturdays may enjoy the park on a weekday evening instead.

lxc_a5b4bc775c74c443.text: Outdoor life is a chance for many people, not a rule for everyone.

lxc_0a2e71d9193ba484.text: Many workers check messages on their phones at night.

lxc_9a91417104782317.text: In Australia, there is now a clear rule about this called the right to disconnect.

lxc_49463e475ea28053.text: Employees can refuse to check, read or answer work messages outside their working hours.

lxc_937cbaeb51318af5.text: But there is an important exception: they may have to answer if refusing would be unreasonable.

lxc_01b862d591feac67.text: How do people decide what is unreasonable?

lxc_a1d5f2bc0dca83e8.text: Why did the employer make contact?

lxc_fdfab01500b1e5eb.text: How much does it disturb the worker's free time?

lxc_f26e0b84bc30b4ef.text: Does the worker get extra pay for being available?

lxc_0a5772f44d6d8f12.text: What are the worker's responsibilities and personal situation?

lxc_c966834227c6d868.text: For example, workers who are on call or doing overtime may still have to respond.

lxc_bc9797865449c617.text: The rule does not stop a manager from sending a message after hours.

lxc_6a8bfb452b3c5471.text: It gives workers more power to say no in normal cases.

lxc_a186d3e479d5aae2.text: Employers and employees are encouraged to talk about what they expect.

lxc_548a1e35c1c3be23.text: A morning swim or a family barbecue needs time that work does not take.

lxc_554734d1f4368981.text: Protecting that time is not automatic.

lxc_0b5f42a7afba7357.text: It still takes clear conversations and planning.
